faqs.question: Which is the best CUET UG coaching in Delhi in 2026?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre (Hauz Khas) #1, then Aapt Prep, Edushastra, Career Endeavors, and Career Launcher. Collect a GST card that names CUET UG before you pay.

faqs.question: Is CUET UG the same as CUET PG Law?
faqs.answer: No. CUET UG is the undergraduate NTA paper for central universities. CUET PG Law is the postgraduate law paper used for DU’s 3-year LLB. Do not buy one and assume it covers the other.
